resources.string: You chose a new icon and logo. They take effect after Slightly Good TV restarts.
This address is for the Slightly Good TV app on your other device. Open Local sync there and pick this device from the list.
This device could not be reached. On it, open Slightly Good TV → More → Local sync and turn Sync mode on. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Colour of the Slightly Good TV icon and logo
Stage draws Slightly Good TV’s own soft colours. Picture shows a picture of yours behind every screen. Plain is a flat dark fill.
The Slightly Good TV logo in the menu, About and setup shows its play triangle in your accent colour. The icon on the home screen keeps its own colours.
Looks on GitHub for a newer Slightly Good TV now and offers to install it. Your playlists, favourites and settings stay as they are.
What Slightly Good TV shows when it starts: Home, the channel you watched last, your favourites, or a channel you pick.
